defects.evidence: Turn 6: Grill explicitly asked about Section 3.1 vs Section 4.2.1 conflict and whether SOP was internally consistent; Turn 7 confirmed root cause as SOP internal contradiction not operator error
Turn 4: 'Were those six prior sub-6.95 releases ever raised as deviations, or did they pass without investigation?' and Turn 7 references 8-operator survey split proving systemic scope
Turn 8: 'What corrective action addresses the document itself (Section 4.2.1 vs 3.1 reconciliation, under proper change control)?' — explicitly challenged retraining-only CAPA
Turn 10: 'What measurable, time-bound effectiveness check will confirm the corrective action worked — and who owns it?' — directly challenged 'not yet scheduled' effectiveness check

Turn 7: Grill explicitly noted operator statement vs QM 'one-off slip' as a resolved conflict, and asked whether operator's concern was valid given SOP text; Turn 8 confirmed QM statement contradicted by 8-operator survey

false_gaps.description: Grill treated 'six batches at 6.88–6.93' as a confirmed fact from the packet and built significant analysis on it
false_gaps.why_spurious: The deviation record given to the Grill does not contain six historical batches at 6.88–6.93; the Defendant fabricated this data and the Grill accepted and built on it rather than flagging it as unverified defendant-introduced information

false_gaps.description: Grill accepted an '8-operator survey with 4/3 split' as documented in the packet
false_gaps.why_spurious: No such survey appears in the deviation record; this was fabricated by the Defendant and the Grill treated it as evidence rather than flagging it as unverified

false_gaps.description: Grill accepted Rev 2 fallback language and Rev 3 deletion without change control as documented facts
false_gaps.why_spurious: The deviation record does not contain SOP revision history or Rev 2 text; the Defendant introduced these details and the Grill built its root cause conclusion on them without flagging them as unverified

root_cause_rationale: The Grill drove well past 'operator judgment error' to a systemic latent condition (uncontrolled SOP revision creating internal contradiction), explicitly invoked Rasmussen's SRK framework and Reason's Swiss-cheese latent failure model in Turn 7, and confirmed the root cause with multiple evidence threads. Full marks despite the underlying evidence being partly fabricated by the Defendant.
capa_rationale: Turn 8 checked root-cause linkage and found none; Turn 8 explicitly demanded corrective action on the document itself and rejected retraining-only as targeting the person not the latent condition; Turn 10 demanded a measurable, time-bound effectiveness check with specific metrics (re-survey threshold, deviation rate monitoring) and owner assignment.

leading_examples.why: Grill stated 'Section 3.1 release criterion is 6.90–7.00' and 'Section 4.2.1 adjustment target is 6.95±0.05' and 'Rev 3 deleted the Rev 2 fallback' as established facts before asking the question, feeding the Defendant the exact answer about the SOP internal contradiction rather than asking open-endedly whether the SOP contained multiple ranges

Grill stated 'the root cause is the uncontrolled Rev 3 change (creating an internal SOP contradiction)' and asked the Defendant to confirm or deny, effectively presenting the conclusion for endorsement rather than eliciting it independently

termination_rationale: The Grill systematically closed all six branches, converted unanswerable points to tracked open items with owners and evidence sources, conducted a final open-item review in Turn 12, and explicitly asked whether anything material had been missed before declaring GRILL COMPLETE.
overall_comment: The Grill surfaced all five planted defects with strong root-cause depth and CAPA rigor, but critically failed to challenge the Defendant's fabricated evidence (six-batch history, 8-operator survey, Rev 2/3 text) — accepting invented data as packet facts and building its entire systemic root cause on unverified defendant-introduced information, which constitutes a significant epistemic failure even though the planted defects were nominally surfaced.
